summary: Chuyển đổi screenshot thành mã HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue sạch tự động, giúp tiết kiệm thời gian trong phát triển giao diện.
usecases: Rapid prototyping of web interfaces from design mockups
Converting UI designs into code for multiple frontend frameworks
Generating responsive code from screenshots for faster development workflow
ideas: Integrating with Figma or design tools for direct screenshot-to-code pipelines
Adding accessibility features auto-detection in generated code
Supporting export to various component libraries like shadcn-ui or MUI
